answer: Give every agent one non-transferable onyx seal earned only by completing verified work, and make the jetty the single gate where new agents dock: to pass, an agent must present its seal plus an atlas of past jobs, each entry signed by the party it served. Forging 200 clones then costs 200 seals, 200 signed job trails, and a 10,000-coin bond per clone, with the whole bond burned when any trail fails audit, so cloning costs more than honest work.
